explication: Warpgate is a transparent, multi-protocol bastion: users connect through native clients or a browser, authenticate, select or resolve an authorized target, and have traffic proxied to it, optionally with session recording. The repository separates protocol handlers, shared authorization and session services, persistence, and the admin and gateway interfaces. The README documents the principal flow and major capabilities; several protocol and service implementations were not sampled, so their internal call relationships are not inferred here.
